name: Trieu Chau Restaurant | Chinese • Cambodian
notes: 4 photos across two different physical menus. Photo1 (leather booklet) shows Rice Plates + Appetizers + Entrees numbered 35-62 at one price set; photo2 shows the same Entrees 46-62 again but noticeably cheaper and with items 51/52 renamed (Pineapple Shrimp / Fried Fish w/ House Fish Sauce instead of Shrimp w/ Lobster Sauce / Fried Fish w/ Black Bean Sauce) - read as an older printed insert, so photo1's Entrees names/prices were kept and photo2's are not duplicated. Photo3 is a drink-only Beverages page, skipped per rules. Photo4 is a separate stir-fry/fried-rice takeout menu (own numbering 17-35); stir-fry noodle dishes are priced only by protein choice (Vegetable/Tofu $10, Chicken/Beef/Pork $11, Shrimp/Seafood $12, Mix $13), so no per-dish price was set for those.
